translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Yawe, kqlex nim murde nim butqbr kx rlakitrx.
Bzkq apume bange kxnradrtqde ngq.
Murde ma tqbzx nzmu napx-ngrn nzxlrngr nzyrni-krnge.
Mzli kc tqobqtr-ngrbo Mrkc Tqtr mz nzmnc-krnge Mangr-nzangiongr nim, x glalzx mqnge mz nzkrka'-krbo bam,
Xlrm natqnge x okatrp ninge.
Bzkq apusr-ngrn ninge kxdrka'-ngrng kcng tzrtrngz-zvzbzng da kxtrka.
X nzrpilr kx nidr ncblo ngr nivz, a' trtingr.
Ayzlu-mopwz mz nzayrplapx-krm nidr mz da kxtrka x nzrtrkalrngr kcng tzalelr,
Kabz badr da kx takitrde nzvz-rbr-krdrng.
Murde matitrpe drtwrdr da kcng tqwz-ngrn x da kxetuting tqaleqng.
Dekc namilxtxo-ngrn nidr x bzkq da kx na-ale-moulr.
Yawe, glqlz-lxblrkr nim
Murde ayzlume natqnge mz nzokatr-krm ninge.
Nim lrpalvc nyznge x temz ngr lomrnge kc tqyrputrngr nipna.
Abrtrpo drtwrnge bam x okatr-zvzq ninge.
Delc tqelalz-ngrm drtwrnge
X tqawi-zvz-ngrbo bam mz nzngrngr.
Yawe, nim lrpalvc nyzgr kx rlakitrkr.
X nim nzxplr-krnge, ninge king kc tqmcpxbzme.
Amrlz nigr leplz nemqng mz nzarlapx-krm nigr,
Mz nzngini-krgr sip nemqng kcng tqaclve-zvzq.
